$comment: Hard gzip KiB ceilings for bundled, minified ESM with optional peers externalized. Reviewed byte measurements use Node 22.23.2, production esbuild, and gzip level 9. Each ceiling must satisfy the maximum headroom policy. The shared default-profile and material correctness review updates only failing entries with 2% headroom; all passing canaries retain their tighter ceilings. The theme entry includes canonical per-look contrast references and batched alias ownership after removal of redundant allocations and unused palette fields; its 13,099-byte measurement retains 2% headroom without changing other ceilings. The two component aggregate ceilings include layout-coordinate corrections for scaled scrolling and retain 2% headroom; all other ceilings remain unchanged. Categorical chart synchronization adds document-scoped coordination and renderer adapters; its 83,797-byte combined measurement retains 2% headroom, rounded up to whole bytes, without changing any other ceiling. Shared select slot readiness, viewport containment and keyboard scrolling increase the layout family by 277 gzip bytes; its 354,218-byte measurement keeps the prior 184-byte absolute allowance at a 354,402-byte ceiling. Currency-picker modules are absent from that family graph; every other ceiling is unchanged. Country, time-zone and unit selectors share one catalog form base; searchable currency and language controls add filtering and keyboard interaction. Their forms-family aggregate measures 260,872 gzip bytes, retaining the existing 2% allowance at 266,089 bytes. Catalog helpers remain granular and the complete-library, individual-control and other family ceilings are unchanged. Semantic popover trigger ownership and button toggle-state support measure 354,760 bytes in the layout family, retaining its existing 184-byte allowance at 354,944 bytes; only this failing direct-entry ceiling changes. The expanded component set and public event contracts have exact measured failing-entry ceilings rounded up to 64-byte boundaries; passing ceilings retain their prior canaries. Memoized toast focus repair adds 25 gzip bytes to the complete barrel and 23 to the overlays barrel; only these two failing ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Native form, editing, selection-veto, disclosure and lifecycle contracts have exact measured failing-entry ceilings rounded up to 64-byte boundaries. The component percentile now measures data-grid resizing and request behavior; the maximum measures agent-workspace composer passthrough. Event-only collection tree shaking removes the menu route regression. The pure root ceiling tightens to its smaller measured bundle; other passing ceilings remain unchanged. Mode-only bootstrap configuration and distinct pressed borders/outlines advance only four failing direct/aggregate ceilings to their next 64-byte boundary; the final measurements retain all other passing ceilings and dependency exclusions. The v28 document token layer (declared once per document instead of per component host), the emoji peer missing-versus-failed diagnostics, the forwarded table pager options and the shared accessible-text readings set every failing direct, aggregate and component ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes, with no headroom; passing ceilings are unchanged. The app-rail auto-hide peek mode advances only the failing direct, aggregate and layout-family ceilings to exactly their measured gzip bytes. Correct Intl option capture, repeated collection snapshots, cancellable QR/PDF resources, and bounded chart/viewer bookkeeping update the exact reviewed measurements. Only breached JavaScript direct-entry and component aggregate ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, retaining at most 63 bytes of allowance; every passing ceiling, peer exclusion, and CSS budget stays unchanged. Image-highlight border limits now use the same normalized zoom as the pan/zoom frame, keeping browser border snapping inside each region. Its five breached complete/media ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary; the layout and viewers measurements update within their existing passing ceilings. The Chromium-only root re-derivation key in the document token runtime and the development-only glass dark share check set every failing ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes; passing ceilings are unchanged. Deferring that key to the first root change beside a static provider sets every failing ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes; passing ceilings are unchanged. Reviewed nested shadow and slot overlay ownership carries open state across component boundaries so sticky cells can raise unfocused menus, with reference-counted cleanup and slot reassignment. The release also includes failed chart-context recovery and heatmap sizing/interaction fixes. Only breached direct-entry and component aggregate ceilings advance to their exact measured gzip bytes, with no added allowance; passing canaries, peer exclusions and CSS budgets remain unchanged. Bounded per-paint heatmap text measurement and ellipsis reuse, weakly retained graph hull paths, and readable command-palette text through highlight transitions advance only seven breached direct-entry ceilings to their exact measured gzip bytes, without added allowance. The data, retrieval and layout families add 376, 105 and 1 bytes respectively; the complete registration barrel adds 512 bytes. Every passing canary, component percentile/maximum, CSS ceiling, initial-route ceiling and optional-peer exclusion remains unchanged. Accessible chart row reuse, duplicate-safe option indexes, active emoji row retention, and localized accessible descriptions add 872 gzip bytes to the complete registration barrel. The four choice and graph lookup indexes are included. Only the fourteen breached direct-entry and two component aggregate ceilings advance to their exact measured bytes, with no added allowance; every passing canary, peer exclusion and CSS ceiling is unchanged. Linear collection reconciliation, cached retrieval membership, and picker normalization add 540 gzip bytes to the complete registration barrel. Only fourteen breached direct-entry ceilings and the component percentile/maximum advance to exact reviewed measurements, without extra allowance; passing canaries and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged. Normalizing preview slot presence before rendering adds 62 gzip bytes to the complete registration barrel. Only seven breached direct-entry ceilings and the component maximum advance to exact measured bytes, without extra allowance; passing ceilings and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged. Native-modal recovery, authored inert-state handling, and filtered combobox selection add 651 gzip bytes to the complete registration barrel. Only thirteen breached direct-entry ceilings and the two component aggregate ceilings advance to their exact reviewed measurements, without extra allowance; passing canaries, CSS ceilings and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged. Sparse option selection avoids allocating queues for unrequested values. This adds 15 gzip bytes to the direct select entry and 17 to the complete registration barrel; only the nine breached direct-entry ceilings advance to exact measured bytes, without extra allowance. Passing canaries, component aggregates, CSS and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged. Rendering native SVG tour masks and reusing one scrim across anchored states corrects the backdrop while eliminating duplicate progress formatting and geometry selectors. After these reductions, only the complete registration barrel exceeds its previous ceiling, by three gzip bytes; its ceiling advances to the exact 1,269,107-byte measurement with no extra allowance. Passing direct-entry, aggregate and CSS ceilings remain unchanged.
